name: Nominal IrisValue decoding uses declared factories only

input.fixture_ref: IrisValue nominal app/User@1 selecting an undeclared factory

applicability.reason: Requires IrisValue decoding plus declared Serializable factories. `IrisValue.decode` answers TypeError for every input measured, so no factory is ever reached to accept or reject.

expect.status: Rejects an undeclared factory without invoking it or publishing a nominal value.
